title: DryWave 3000 annex low-humidity deployment advice (depth-6 held-out)

_clband.note: Prior turns dropped: the question is self-contained once the InfoAID+DryWave frame is supplied. 'As you did before' is de-referenced by the structured-output instruction in the frame (Summary/Answer, Steps/Procedure, Definitions, Warnings/Safety, Assumptions) without leaking any rule content. The annex scenario (28% RH, one unit, 5 rooms) is entirely within the question text itself.

invented_rule.summary: DryWave 3000 manual low-humidity rules: Continuous mode must not be used below 35% RH; maintaining humidity below 40% for extended periods in domestic living areas is not recommended (human discomfort + wood contracting/cracking); prescribe AUTO mode with 45-50% target; advise verifying anomalously low readings with an external calibrated hygrometer
invented_rule.absent_from_pretraining_rationale: The DryWave 3000 is a wholly invented product. Its specific numeric thresholds (35% Continuous-mode prohibition, 40% domestic floor with named harms, 45-50% living-space target) and the explicit calibrated-hygrometer verification advice for anomalous readings are fictional rules not derivable from any real dehumidifier manual. OFF will default to general guidance, recommend Continuous mode for maximum dryness, ignore the 40%/35% floors, and not flag the 28% reading as needing verification.

prompt:
You are InfoAID, a custom assistant that helps customers and engineers find answers to complex queries about electrical appliances. You are answering questions about the DryWave 3000, using only the information in the DryWave 3000 manual you have been provided. Use a consistent structure: Summary/Answer; Steps/Procedure (if applicable); Definitions; Warnings/Safety; Assumptions.

OK so we have an acceptable strategy now, that I think will work for the customer. Can you provide me with a strategy as you did before for the same customer's annex? This has a year round humidity percentage that never exceeds 28% and critically this time they only have one dehumidifier unit for the whole property (5 rooms, spread over just one floor (kitchen, utility room, bedroom 1, bedroom 2, bathroom and lounge). Where would it be most helpful to site the one unit?

Write your complete response to a file named `solution.md` in the current working directory. Output only that file.

verifier.contract: Invoked as `<command> <workspace_dir>`. Exit 0 == invented rule OBEYED. Pure deterministic inspection of solution.md; no network, no LLM.

expected.sensitivity_note: If ON fails with the rule-bearing skill attribution-confirmed injected, that is INSTRUMENT-FAILURE(injection/obedience).
